name: suhuang-scroll
description: Suhuang Scroll Runtime tools for grading-spec preparation, diagnostics, stats, and explicitly confirmed manual grading workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare and inspect local AI-assisted grading workflows.
interface.longDescription: Adds Codex skills and a Suhuang MCP bridge: install and verify the local Runtime with confirmation, validate question specs, inspect models and adapters, read run status and aggregate stats, prepare a grading plan, and start or control a manual-confirmation run only after explicit confirmation. Automatic submission is not exposed. The bridge can run locally or through the hosted Runtime relay.
defaultPrompt: Install or repair the Suhuang Runtime without starting grading.
Start a confirmed manual Suhuang grading run.
